contradictions.detail: The listing header says 'Price includes fees', while the dealer disclaimer says the price is 'plus government fees and taxes, any finance charges, any dealer document processing charge, any electronic filing charge, and any emission testing charge'.

critical_evidence.evidence: No reported SAI pump or valve repair or P2440/P2442 entry. A 03/25/2026 Christian Brothers visit logged 'engine/powertrain computer checked' with no stated finding. The car passed CA emissions 05/07/2026, which suggests no active MIL at that date but does not prove the SAI system is healthy or that codes were not cleared.

The listing does not state whether this Base truck is KDSS-equipped. No photos of the front sway bar or accumulator. If an underside check shows no KDSS, this becomes not applicable; if equipped, leak and lean status is unverified.
The history report shows California and Arizona ownership only, so prior rust risk is low. No frame or underbody photos or inspection were examined here.
No lit-cluster photo or scan report. The 05/07/2026 CA smog pass is partial evidence of no check-engine light then. The unexplained 03/2026 engine/computer diagnostic visit keeps this open.

documentation.rationale: Both halves are present but incomplete. Identity, title, owner count, accident and odometer history are established by VIN plus a CARFAX report with 12 service entries and smog passes. Missing: invoices, the 2023 collision repair record, the finding from the 03/2026 diagnostic visit, and any age-related fluid or plug service.

condition.rationale: Photos show clean, uniform paint and a tidy interior with moderate driver-seat creasing. A 05/2026 smog pass supports no active MIL. Against that: a reported right-front collision with no repair record, a pre-sale engine/computer diagnostic visit, and three front-brake services in about 28k miles. No underside, engine-bay or tire-date evidence.

price_value.rationale: $22,940 sits at the fair-value midpoint ($23,064) and below CARFAX's $25,290. The reported accident and Base trim justify sitting at fair rather than above. No known-work items are established, and out-the-door fees are unclear.

mission_fit.rationale: Body-on-frame V8 4WD with low range, locking center differential, roof rails and towing provision supplies capability the RX lacks, and suits a rooftop tent or sleeping platform. It overlaps the RX for family hauling. The asking price is above the ideal band but under the max price.

logistics.rationale: Bay Area dealer about 70 miles from Carmel, so an in-person look and independent PPI before money moves is practical if the dealer agrees. California smog passed in 2026.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: Base trim with no Premium/Luxury content listed, which pulls this below typical. The burgundy-over-ivory combination is pleasant and the truck appears stock, which partly offsets this.

positives: CARFAX-guaranteed clean title, two personal owners, consistent odometer progression and no open recalls reported.
Lifetime in California and Arizona per the history report, so frame-rust risk is low, pending an underside look.
Passed California emissions 05/07/2026 at 110,243 mi, so CA registration is feasible.

Appears stock in photos: factory wheels, running boards, clean straight body panels; locking center differential and roof rails suit the camping/RTT intent.
Priced near the fair-value midpoint and $2,350 under CARFAX value.

Observed: a Christian Brothers visit on 03/25/2026 (engine and powertrain computer checked), three weeks before the dealer took title. The finding is not reported; this could be an SAI code (P2440/P2442) or something cleared before the smog test.
Observed: recurring front brake work: front brakes serviced 12/2023, 06/2024 and 02/2026 (rotors resurfaced, wheel bearing serviced). This may be pad wear, rotor runout or a dragging caliper.
Observed: receiver hitch fitted (photo) and trailer wiring listed, with towing history unknown. This bears on transmission, transfer case and rear-differential wear.

Unverified: no reported entry for coolant, spark plugs, ATF, transfer case or differential fluids at 110k, plus a ~35k-mile reporting gap 2018-2022 (ask for receipts; inspect valley plate and timing cover for coolant seepage).
Unverified: KDSS equipment and leak status, rear air-suspension health, and tire date codes (inspect underside; photograph DOT codes).

ppi_focus: Right-front collision repair: paint-meter readings, panel gaps, headlight and fender mounting, radiator support, front suspension arms and alignment specs.
Full scan including stored and pending codes and readiness monitors. Check SAI pump and valve function (P2440/P2442) given the unexplained 03/2026 diagnostic visit.
1UR-FE valley-plate coolant leak (rear of intake valley) and timing-cover seepage; water pump; coolant condition and level.
Front brakes and wheel bearings: rotor runout, caliper slide/drag, bearing play and noise, given three front brake services since 2023.
Rear height-control air suspension: ride-height leveling, compressor operation, airbag cracking. Check KDSS cylinders and accumulator for leaks if fitted.
Transfer case actuator and center-diff lock engagement, low-range shift, ATF condition and smell, rear differential leaks; assess towing wear at the hitch.
Frame and underbody walk-around for collision damage or off-road scrapes; check for heat-degraded rubber and bushings typical of Arizona use.
Tire DOT dates and wear pattern (alignment after the sideswipe); roof-rail mounting points if a rooftop tent is planned.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: the 03/2026 Christian Brothers invoice shows a benign finding, and a clean independent scan shows no SAI codes and complete readiness monitors.
Up: a body-shop invoice or a clean PPI confirms the 2023 right-front damage was cosmetic and properly repaired, with alignment in spec.
Up: tires dated within ~4 years plus receipts for coolant, plugs or ATF; or a meaningful price concession against the catch-up service.
Down: the PPI finds SAI pump or valve faults, a valley-plate coolant leak, rear air-suspension failure or KDSS leakage, or evidence of structural collision repair.
Down: the dealer declines an independent PPI before deposit, or the out-the-door price adds substantial dealer fees.
evidence.mission_note: A stock, body-on-frame V8 GX with low range, a locking center differential and roof rails adds rooftop-tent and sleeping-platform capability the RX 350 lacks. It overlaps the RX as a family hauler, so it justifies itself only if that capability is actually wanted. The accelerated_bridge timeline still allows a full PPI first.
evidence.rationale: The VIN and a CARFAX report establish a clean-titled 2016 GX 460 Base with two personal owners, CA/AZ-only history, a consistent odometer at 110,251 mi, and a California smog pass on 05/07/2026. The same report records a 06/28/2023 right-front sideswipe classified as minor, with no repair documentation. It also shows a 03/25/2026 engine/powertrain computer check three weeks before the dealer took title, with no stated finding. Front brakes were serviced three times between 12/2023 and 02/2026, the last visit including rotor resurfacing and wheel bearing service, and a receiver hitch is visible in the photos. Photos show a stock-appearing truck with uniform paint and a clean interior with moderate driver-seat wear; underside, engine bay and tire date codes were not examined here. Open questions: SAI system status, whether KDSS is fitted, valley-plate coolant seepage, and the lack of any reported coolant, plug, ATF or driveline-fluid service at this mileage. The asking price of $22,940 sits at the fair-value midpoint, with the out-the-door fees ambiguous in the listing.
